title: schedonorus madritensis var. ciliatus
intro: Schedonorus madritensis var. ciliatus, commonly known as sweet woodruff, is a perennial flowering plant that belongs to the grass family (Poaceae). This herb is known for its numerous health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which can help to soothe digestive issues, reduce stress, and promote relaxation. The therapeutic actions of sweet woodruff include its ability to calm the nervous system, reduce anxiety, and alleviate symptoms of insomnia. The bioactive constituents of sweet woodruff include essential oils, flavonoids, and coumarins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and contribute to its use in traditional herbal medicine.
